A farmer had an old donkey. <break time="0.8s" /> For many years, he carried sacks to the mill. <break time="0.8s" /> Now he was old, and the farmer did not want him. <break time="0.8s" /> So the donkey ran away to Bremen. <break time="0.8s" /> I can be a town musician there, he thought. <break time="0.8s" /> On the road, he met an old dog. <break time="0.8s" /> The dog was too old to hunt. <break time="0.8s" /> Come with me to Bremen, said the donkey.

한 농부가 가지고 있었어요 늙은 당나귀 한 마리를. <break time="0.8s" /> 여러 해 동안. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 자루를 날랐어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 방앗간까지. <break time="0.8s" /> 이제 그는 늙었어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 농부는 그를 원하지 않았어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래서 당나귀는 떠나 버렸어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 브레멘으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 거기서 나는 도시 악사가 될 수 있어. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 생각했어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 길에서 그는 늙은 개를 만났어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 개는 너무 늙었어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 사냥을 하기에는. <break time="0.8s" /> 나랑 같이 가자. <break time="0.8s" /> 브레멘으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 당나귀가 말했어요.

Next they met a sad old cat. <break time="0.8s" /> She was too old. <break time="0.8s" /> To catch mice. <break time="0.8s" /> So the cat went. <break time="0.8s" /> With them, too. <break time="0.8s" /> Then they saw a rooster. <break time="0.8s" /> On a gate. <break time="0.8s" /> The cook wants to put me. <break time="0.8s" /> In the soup he cried. <break time="0.8s" /> You have a good voice. <break time="0.8s" /> Come with us. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the donkey. <break time="0.8s" /> At night the four friends were in a big forest. <break time="0.8s" /> From the top of a tree. <break time="0.8s" /> The rooster saw a light.

다음으로 그들은 슬픈 늙은 고양이를 만났어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 고양이는 너무 늙었어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 쥐를 잡기에는. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래서 고양이도 갔어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들과 함께. <break time="0.8s" /> 그다음 그들은 수탉을 보았어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 대문 위에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 요리사가 나를 넣으려고 해요. <break time="0.8s" /> 수프에 수탉이 소리쳤어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 너는 목소리가 좋구나. <break time="0.8s" /> 우리랑 같이 가자. <break time="0.8s" /> 당나귀가 말했어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 밤에 네 친구는 있었어요 큰 숲속에. <break time="0.8s" /> 나무 꼭대기에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 수탉은 불빛 하나를 보았어요.

They walked to the light. <break time="0.8s" /> And found a house. <break time="0.8s" /> The donkey was the tallest. <break time="0.8s" /> So he looked in the window. <break time="0.8s" /> Robbers were at a table. <break time="0.8s" /> With lots of good food. <break time="0.8s" /> The animals. <break time="0.8s" /> Made a plan. <break time="0.8s" /> They stood. <break time="0.8s" /> On top of each other. <break time="0.8s" /> At the window. <break time="0.8s" /> The donkey brayed. <break time="0.8s" /> The dog barked. <break time="0.8s" /> The cat meowed. <break time="0.8s" /> And the rooster crowed. <break time="0.8s" /> They crashed through the window. <break time="0.8s" /> Into the room. <break time="0.8s" /> The robbers thought. <break time="0.8s" /> It was a ghost. <break time="0.8s" /> And ran away.

그들은 불빛 쪽으로 걸어갔어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 집 한 채를 찾았어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 당나귀가 키가 가장 컸어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래서 그가 창문 안을 들여다보았어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 도둑들이 식탁에 둘러앉아 있었어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 식탁에는 맛있는 음식이 가득했어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 동물들은. <break time="0.8s" /> 계획을 세웠어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 올라섰어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 서로의 등 위에. <break time="0.8s" /> 창문 앞에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 당나귀는 히힝 울었어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 개는 멍멍 짖었어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 고양이는 야옹 울었어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 수탉은 꼬끼오 울었어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 와장창 창문을 뚫고 나갔어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 방 안으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 도둑들은 생각했어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 유령이라고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 도망쳤어요.

The friends ate the food. <break time="0.8s" /> And went to sleep. <break time="0.8s" /> Late at night a robber came back. <break time="0.8s" /> He thought. <break time="0.8s" /> The cats eyes were hot coals. <break time="0.8s" /> The cat scratched him. <break time="0.8s" /> And the dog bit him. <break time="0.8s" /> The donkey kicked him. <break time="0.8s" /> And the rooster cried. <break time="0.8s" /> Cock a doodle doo. <break time="0.8s" /> A witch and a monster. <break time="0.8s" /> Are in that house. <break time="0.8s" /> He told the others. <break time="0.8s" /> The robbers. <break time="0.8s" /> Never came back again. <break time="0.8s" /> The four friends liked the house. <break time="0.8s" /> And stayed there.

친구들은 음식을 먹었어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 잠자리에 들었어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 밤늦게 도둑 한 명이 돌아왔어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 생각했어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 고양이의 눈이 뜨거운 숯불이라고. <break time="0.8s" /> 고양이는 그를 할퀴었어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 개는 그를 물었어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 당나귀는 그를 발로 찼어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 수탉은 울었어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 꼬끼오. <break time="0.8s" /> 마녀랑 괴물이. <break time="0.8s" /> 저 집에 있어. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 다른 도둑들에게 말했어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 도둑들은. <break time="0.8s" /> 다시는 돌아오지 않았어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 네 친구는 그 집이 마음에 들었어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그곳에 머물렀어요.
